🚀 [DeepAgent is now Abacus AI Agent](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction)

On this page

### How much is the ChatLLM subscription? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-much-is-the-chatllm-subscription "Direct link to How much is the ChatLLM subscription?")

A ChatLLM subscription is $10 per user per month. You will be billed $10 when you sign up. You can cancel anytime, and your subscription will stay active for the month.

You can also upgrade to the Pro tier for an additional $10 a month. The Pro tier gives you unrestricted access to Abacus AI Agent and Abacus AI Studio. You can use Abacus AI Agent for however many tasks you like, as long as you have active credits in the account.

### What is the difference between the Basic and Pro tier? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#what-is-the-difference-between-the-basic-and-pro-tier "Direct link to What is the difference between the Basic and Pro tier?")

**Basic Tier**

- $10/month
- 20K credits
- Limited Abacus AI Agent access (3 tasks of limited complexity)
- Limited Abacus AI Studio access (max 3 conversations; max 2.5K credits per conversation — upgrade required beyond these limits)

**Pro Tier**

- $20 total/month (Basic + Pro)
- 30K credits (includes +10K from Pro)
- Unrestricted Abacus AI Agent access with active credits
- Unrestricted Abacus AI Studio access with active credits (no conversation cap, no per-conversation credit cap)
- Stronger AI models for richer results
- 🚀 **Access to SuperComputer** — your always-on computer for APIs and persistent agents, able to build, deploy, and host agents, APIs, and databases

### How many credits do I get in the Basic Tier? What happens if I receive a first month promotion? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-many-credits-do-i-get-in-the-basic-tier-what-happens-if-i-receive-a-first-month-promotion "Direct link to How many credits do I get in the Basic Tier? What happens if I receive a first month promotion?")

You typically get 20K credits as part of the Basic Tier. This should be plenty of credits to send 1000s of messages.

If there is a promotion running on the Basic Tier, then you will get a lower amount of credits. For example, if you only paid $7 to access the Basic Tier, you will only receive 14k credits.

### What is the Pro tier and what advantages does it give me? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#what-is-the-pro-tier-and-what-advantages-does-it-give-me "Direct link to What is the Pro tier and what advantages does it give me?")

The Pro tier costs an additional $10 monthly and gives you unrestricted access to Abacus AI Agent and Abacus AI Studio. You can use all of your active credits on Abacus AI Agent and Abacus AI Studio tasks.

The Pro tier also uses a much more powerful version of Abacus AI Agent. This means your tasks will yield better and richer results.

Pro also unlocks the **SuperComputer** — your always-on computer for APIs and persistent agents that can build, deploy, and host agents, APIs, and databases for you. See the question below for more.

Finally, the Pro Tier gives you an additional 10000 credits. Please read about credits below.

### Does upgrading to Pro unlock the SuperComputer? 🚀 [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#does-upgrading-to-pro-unlock-the-supercomputer- "Direct link to Does upgrading to Pro unlock the SuperComputer? 🚀")

Absolutely — and it's a game-changer. **The SuperComputer is exclusive to Pro.** The moment you upgrade, you unlock your very own always-on cloud computer, supercharged with AI agents that work for you around the clock.

With the SuperComputer you can:

- 🛠️ **Build anything with a prompt** — persistent agents, APIs, and servers in any programming language
- ☁️ **Deploy & host any cloud service** — spin up cloud servers, databases, or any open-source software
- 🧠 **Use any LLM you want** — bring your own model or use ours, and power every agent with the best LLM for the job
- ⚡ **Run always-on agents** — deploy persistent agents like Hermes and Claw that never clock out

Think of it as an entire cloud engineering team in your back pocket. One upgrade to Pro — infinite possibilities.

### How does billing work for Abacus AI SuperComputer? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-does-billing-work-for-abacus-ai-supercomputer "Direct link to How does billing work for Abacus AI SuperComputer?")

Abacus AI SuperComputer is available to Pro Tier users and above and costs 1 credit per 5 minutes while it is running. You only pay for active runtime, so you can start it when needed and stop it when you are done. To help optimize credit usage, SuperComputer also auto-shuts down when nothing is running.

Usage of the Abacus AI agent or Abacus AI CLI inside the SuperComputer is billed separately. For details on Pro Tier pricing, credits, and plan limits, check the FAQs [here](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing#what-is-the-pro-tier-and-what-advantages-does-it-give-me).

### What are the usage limits on the LLMs? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#what-are-the-usage-limits-on-the-llms "Direct link to What are the usage limits on the LLMs?")

Our LLM usage limits are more generous than other paid services. On SOTA LLMs like GPT-5.2, Sonnet-4.5, or Gemini 3, you can send thousands of messages without attachments without hitting a usage limit.

We give you 20K credits every month. These credits can be used for various operations, including sending messages to the top LLMs, creating videos and images, and generating documents.

**PLEASE NOTE** \- these credits are NOT TOKENS, and you can get up to 15M input tokens for some expensive models like Sonnet-4.5 and GPT-5.2 with these credits and 70M tokens on others.

In addition, you can use the RouteLLM, GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K2.7 Code, Muse Spark 1.3, and MiMo V2.6 Pro models without ANY LIMITS.

If you choose to use credits for video, audio, or document generation, we will deduct credits proportional to the current market rate of those services. Typically, this translates to around 500 images or 25 Abacus AI Agent tasks in a month from a premium service. Video generation is available through Abacus AI Studio. Basic tier: max 3 conversations, max 5,000 credits per conversation. Pro tier: unrestricted access with active credits.

Our SOTA image models include GPT Image 2.6, Nano Banana Pro, FLUX.2, Flux Kontext, Seedream, Recraft, and Ideogram. For high-quality image generation, we recommend Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2.6. For video generation, our SOTA video models include Sora 2, KlingAI, Wan, Lumalabs, Hailuo, and RunwayML. These models are compute-intensive and may consume more credits per task.

### What models can I use on an unlimited basis? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#what-models-can-i-use-on-an-unlimited-basis "Direct link to What models can I use on an unlimited basis?")

You can use RouteLLM, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3, and Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 Pro on an unlimited basis. Typically, new models from the Gemini Flash Lite and GPT Mini families, as well as leading open-weight models, will be offered on an unlimited basis in ChatLLM (but not via the RouteLLM API).

It's important to note that these will still accrue credits on an ongoing basis, but you will be able to continue using them even after hitting the credit limit. Unlimited use is meant for personal use: very heavy use after the credit limit can pause these models for the rest of the day, or until your plan renews or you buy credits.

### Where can I see the credits? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#where-can-i-see-the-credits "Direct link to Where can I see the credits?")

You can always see credits on your profile's billing page. For a detailed log on your usage, click 'View Credit Usage' on your profile. We also show credits against each message if you are using them up quickly. If you want to always view the credits used for each message, you can do so by activating the toggle on your profile.

### Do my purchased credits disappear if I don’t use them within the month? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#do-my-purchased-credits-disappear-if-i-dont-use-them-within-the-month "Direct link to Do my purchased credits disappear if I don’t use them within the month?")

No, your purchased credits roll over to the following month if unused.

Please note that this is separate from the monthly 20K credits that come with your subscription – these reset to 20K on your renewal date.

### How much does it cost to host apps on Abacus AI? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-much-does-it-cost-to-host-apps-on-abacus-ai "Direct link to How much does it cost to host apps on Abacus AI?")

Abacus.AI provides a generous free tier for database, file hosting, and app server management (up to 25,000 credits per month) until your app starts receiving significant traffic. Beyond that, charges apply. For more detailed information, click [here](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/pricing-apps).

### Why don't you have exact credits published per model? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#why-dont-you-have-exact-credits-published-per-model "Direct link to Why don't you have exact credits published per model?")

Credits are just a measure of the usage of our entire service. This includes our AI engineer, AI Workflows, LLMs, Video Generators, and Image Generators. We constantly add new models, change model rates, and make the product more efficient. This is why you can only see credits after usage. That said, we are very generous concerning our rate limits, and you can always monitor your credits on the billing page. We will show it for every generation or message when we think you are using too many.

Some models, such as o3-pro and Claude Opus 4.5, are more compute-intensive and may consume more credits per task. This is why we recommend monitoring your credit usage on the billing page.

### What is this 75% usage message I’m receiving? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#what-is-this-75-usage-message-im-receiving "Direct link to What is this 75% usage message I’m receiving?")

The limit exists because the 10K credits cost $10, and we give you a generous amount of 20K credits every month, but the idea is to spread it for the entire month. If you want to spend more credits, you can always buy more.

You can use the last 25% on the last week of your subscription

### How does the API work? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-does-the-api-work "Direct link to How does the API work?")

API usage is billed the same way as everything else. The more API calls you make the more credits you will consume. Credit consumption will be based on the price of the LLM used. These prices are some of the cheapest on the planet and are listed directly in the RouteLLM API page available [here](https://abacus.ai/app/route-llm-apis).

API usage can be seen on the [Credit Usage Log](https://apps.abacus.ai/chatllm/admin/compute-points-usage?groupBy=source) by checking "Group by Source". This records API usage on a daily basis. A more detailed breakdown of RouteLLM API usage will be available shortly.

### How many users can I invite? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-many-users-can-i-invite "Direct link to How many users can I invite?")

There is no limit to the number of users you can invite! You will be billed on a monthly basis based on the size of your team. In addition, you will be billed immediately for every additional user you invite at a rate of $10/user/month.

### If I get invited to a team, do I have to pay? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#if-i-get-invited-to-a-team-do-i-have-to-pay "Direct link to If I get invited to a team, do I have to pay?")

No, the owner of the team organization will get the invoice for your membership on that team. If you are being prompted to pay, you likely need to switch organizations so you are on the team organization and not your own organization.

### How can I view my past payments? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-can-i-view-my-past-payments "Direct link to How can I view my past payments?")

You can view all past payments by going to your profile and navigating to the Billing and Invoices page. There, you will be able to see your payment details and history. You will also be able to download past invoices and update your payment information.

### How can I change my billing/invoice information? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-can-i-change-my-billinginvoice-information "Direct link to How can I change my billing/invoice information?")

Click on your Profile at the top right, then click on Profile & Billing. Click on Billing Details, then Update Address. Similarly, on the Billing Details page, you can also update your Card information.

### How can I cancel my subscription? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-can-i-cancel-my-subscription "Direct link to How can I cancel my subscription?")

You can cancel anytime from the Abacus.AI ChatLLM interface. Billing subscription details are available on the desktop interface by clicking on your name or organization in the top right corner and on Profile. “Cancel Subscription” should be located at the bottom right of the page.

### How do I delete my credit card from my account? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-do-i-delete-my-credit-card-from-my-account "Direct link to How do I delete my credit card from my account?")

To delete your credit card, you need to delete your account—email [support@abacus.ai](mailto:support@abacus.ai) for assistance.

### How do I delete my account? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#how-do-i-delete-my-account "Direct link to How do I delete my account?")

In order to delete your account, please contact us at [support@abacus.ai](mailto:support@abacus.ai) and we will handle it for you.

### I would like to access certain Enterprise features. What is the price point of the enterprise plan? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#i-would-like-to-access-certain-enterprise-features-what-is-the-price-point-of-the-enterprise-plan "Direct link to I would like to access certain Enterprise features. What is the price point of the enterprise plan?")

The starting price point for Abacus.AI Enterprise is $5000. If you are interested, email [support@abacus.ai](mailto:support@abacus.ai) or [sales@abacus.ai](mailto:sales@abacus.ai) to be properly connected to the right person.

### There’s been a mistake in my billing. How do I get this fixed? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#theres-been-a-mistake-in-my-billing-how-do-i-get-this-fixed "Direct link to There’s been a mistake in my billing. How do I get this fixed?")

If you think your billing is incorrect, email [support@abacus.ai](mailto:support@abacus.ai) and someone will investigate.

### What are the limitations for the commercial use of images generated using the Abacus.AI platform? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#what-are-the-limitations-for-the-commercial-use-of-images-generated-using-the-abacusai-platform "Direct link to What are the limitations for the commercial use of images generated using the Abacus.AI platform?")

There are no restrictions or limitations. No one owns the rights of AI generated images, so you can use them freely across any sector.

### My AI model, AI Workflow, or Abacus AI Agent isn't doing exactly what I want. Can I get a refund? [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/billing\#refund "Direct link to My AI model, AI Workflow, or Abacus AI Agent isn't doing exactly what I want. Can I get a refund?")

Our AI models and Abacus AI Agent are provided as-is. Their behavior is influenced by how they are prompted, the nature of the tasks you're asking them to perform, and the complexity involved. While we continuously work to enhance their capabilities, we can't guarantee perfect performance for every prompt or scenario.

We recommend that you simplify or clarify your instructions. You can check out our Prompting Tips and Tricks. Even small adjustments to your prompt or task complexity can lead to significantly better outcomes.

Keep in mind that some tasks may be too complex for an AI—or even a human—to complete in just a few minutes.

As with most AI services, we do not offer refunds based on the model's output or performance.
